content:
RevenueCat's annual Shipaton mobile hackathon is officially back, running from August 1 to September 30, with winning apps eligible for substantial prizes. Here are the details.

Shipaton 2026 is now underway, with a deadline of September 30, and winning apps can receive generous prizes.

Have you ever had an idea for an app? Until recently, building an app was considered a daunting task that required someone with professional coding skills to complete. However, with the rise of AI-powered coding tools, anyone today—even with zero experience—can develop and launch a great app.

To encourage and nurture a new wave of apps, RevenueCat has just kicked off its annual Shipaton competition, the world's largest mobile hackathon.

The rules are pretty simple: eligibility requires launching a brand-new app between August 1 and September 30, and using the RevenueCat SDK for monetization.

Cash prizes total over US$700,000, with the overall prize pool exceeding US$1 million. There are as many as 20 categories, including a dedicated "Student Prize."

Winners' apps will also be featured on a large billboard in New York's Times Square. They will also be invited to attend a red-carpet event held in New York, taking the stage in person to receive their trophies.

You can sign up for this year's Shipaton here.

All participants will receive a "Ship Kit" upon registration, containing coupons, discounts, and credits to help them build and grow their apps.

In addition, RevenueCat will host live-streamed sessions twice a week, led by its staff and industry experts, helping participants learn how to build and grow a mobile app business.

You can also network with other participants through more than 40 "Shipaton IRL" in-person events held around the world.

For full event details, visit shipaton.com, where you can also register.
